definitions.explanation: The time from noon until evening, or the PM hours when telling time.

examples.japanese: {午後|ごご}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}ります→降る：00839_furu⟧。
examples.english: It will rain from the afternoon.
The meeting is from 2 PM to 4 PM.

examples.japanese: {午後|ごご}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{昼|ひる}ごはん→昼ご飯：02950_hirugohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{食|た}べました→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I have a lot of work this afternoon, so I ate lunch early.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{午後|ごご}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}こう→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っています→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I don't have any plans this afternoon, so I'm thinking of going to see a movie with my friend.

notes:
{午後|ごご} refers to the afternoon or PM hours (after noon until evening).

TIME EXPRESSIONS:
- {午後|ごご}〜⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧: X PM (e.g., {午後|ごご}3⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧ = 3 PM)
- {午後|ごご}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from the afternoon
- {午後|ごご}⟦{中|じゅう}→中：noentry⟧: all afternoon

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{午後|ごご}: this afternoon
- {午後|ごご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧: afternoon classes
- {午後|ごご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ひととき→ひととき：10494_hitotoki⟧: an afternoon moment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{午前|ごぜん}→午前：00548_gozen⟧: AM, morning (before noon)
- {午後|ごご}: PM, afternoon (after noon)
- ⟦{正午|しょうご}→正午：03231_shougo⟧: noon (exactly 12:00)

USAGE:
In Japan, 24-hour time is common in schedules (e.g., 15:00 instead of {午後|ごご}3⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧), but {午後|ごご} is widely used in conversation.
